pivotal_result: STRIVE (VX08-770-102), a randomised, double-blind, placebo-controlled trial in subjects 12 years of age or older with cystic fibrosis and at least one G551D-CFTR mutation (84 assigned to ivacaftor 150 mg every 12 hours, 83 to placebo): the change in percent of predicted FEV1 through week 24 was greater by 10.6 percentage points in the ivacaftor group than in the placebo group (P less than 0.001); through week 48, subjects receiving ivacaftor were 55% less likely to have a pulmonary exacerbation, gained on average 2.7 kg more weight, and sweat chloride changed by -48.1 mmol per liter compared with placebo. Trial registration NCT00909532; paper DOI 10.1056/NEJMoa1105185.
